sentences.text:
3. Learned A.G.A. submits on the basis of the counter affidavit filed in the matter that the investigation has already been concluded with submission of the charge sheet against the accused persons on 15.06.2024.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner although states that statement of the victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. has not been recorded, but in the same breath she admits that despite repeated notices issued to her, she has not appeared before the Investigation Officer for getting her statement recorded.

5. If that be so, it would be open for the investigating officer to conclude the investigation on the basis of the material collecting during investigation and once it is found that prima facie commission of offence is indicated, charge sheet can be submitted.

Since charge sheet has already been filed, we opine that substantial grievance of the petitioner stands redressed and all other aspects can be agitated before the competent Court at the appropriate stage.
6. Subject to observations made above, this petition is consigned to records.
